posts.text:
Saturday, Nov 21: Toronto's streetcars lost 957 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 510 Spadina northbound. A typical 5.5 km trip lost 14 min (usually 13).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch westbound, 11 min over 8.0 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Saturday's slowest spot: Southbound on Spadina Ave, between Queen St W and Adelaide St W.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 9 s here (usually 1 min 45 s). Across 217 trips, that adds up to 7.8 hours.
The biggest share was at the Adelaide St W light, which has no transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Spadina Ave around Queen St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch between Queen St W and Adelaide St W is highlighted, adding up to about 2 min 9 s lost per streetcar.

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Saturday, Nov 21: 510 Spadina. 1 in 10 trips (52) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side (southbound, 28), instead of going on to Union Station.

Across all routes, 6% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 510 Spadina route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side, gives how many southbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Union Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Saturday, Nov 21: westbound at Strachan Ave & Fleet St.

45% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 275 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Strachan Ave & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the westbound approach reads 45% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Saturday, Nov 21: at the busiest moment (2:30 pm), 148 streetcars were in service, against 149 scheduled.
Overall, 98% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 892 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 92% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Saturday, Nov 21, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 148 streetcars at 2:30 pm, against 149 scheduled; over the day 98% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Saturday, Nov 21: Howard Park Ave at Indian Rd (506 Carlton westbound).

Riders waited 8.9 min on average, against 5.0 if cars had come as scheduled: 4.0 min extra. 27% of cars came bunched, and 24 of 120 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Howard Park Ave at Indian Rd in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 4.0 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
